title: The Expected Number of Pairwise Stable Networks
summary: This paper studies probabilistic properties of pairwise stability for a network model where individual utilities are random variables. We study the probability that a given network is pairwise stable and the expected number of pairwise stable networks. We provide a closed-form solution for the latter number.
